title: The servant became the mistress
odia:
ଖଡ଼ୁ ବିକି କରି ରଖିଲଇ ଦାସୀ
ସେ ହେଲା ସାଆନ୍ତାଣୀ
ମୁଁ ପରବାସୀ।
literal_meaning: I sold bangles and kept a female servant; she became the mistress of the household, and I a stranger living away from home.
meaning_odia: ଖଡ଼ୁ ବିକି ଯାହାକୁ ଦାସୀ ଭାବେ ରଖାଗଲା, ସେ ସାଆନ୍ତାଣୀ ହେଲା; ଯିଏ ରଖିଥିଲା, ସେ ପରବାସୀ ହେଲା। ନିଜ ସମ୍ବଳ ଦେଇ ଆଣିଥିବା ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଶେଷରେ ନିଜ ସ୍ଥାନ ହରାଇବା ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ିଯିବାର ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଭାବେ ଏହାକୁ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The speaker begins by paying a personal cost to retain help. By the end, the person brought in as a servant occupies the position of mistress, while the speaker is away from home. This editorial reading hears a complaint about a reversal of power that leaves its original provider displaced.
usage_example: In a fictional tale, a character gives up valuables to bring someone into the household, then loses their own place there. A reader compares that reversal with these lines. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The bangles make the initial sacrifice concrete. ଦାସୀ, ସାଆନ୍ତାଣୀ and ପରବାସୀ then trace the change in position through three roles: servant, household mistress and displaced speaker. The verse leaves the means of that reversal untold.

odia_summary: ନିଜ ସମ୍ବଳରେ ରଖିଥିବା ଦାସୀ ସାଆନ୍ତାଣୀ ହେଲା, ବକ୍ତା ପରବାସୀ।
english_summary: The speaker pays to retain help, then loses their place as the servant becomes mistress.
